soundness_flags.label: ass:q-dependence; thm:native-second-order-transfer; thm:feasible-window-wald
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated pairwise independence of epsilon_it and epsilon_is beyond q is not finite-range dependence of the row process; replace it with sigma-field/block q-dependence (or another stated CLT and conditional-neighborhood condition) before invoking replacement conditioning and a uniform CLT.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:sharp-phase-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The OEQ ranges over g asymp n^b for b in (0,1], but every theorem it depends on uses model class P_n with ass:cohort-fraction, which fixes g asymp n; define exponent-indexed classes and rerun the primitive assumptions before claiming a b-frontier.
